smoke.description: Foundation installs and loads on a real server

core-log.description: Logger lines reach the server console intact
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: progress 100% done %s %d note=\*\*\* password=\*\*\*$
\[foundation\] WARN  foundation-core-log-test/repeat: previous message repeated 2 more time\(s\)$

core-audit.description: Audit records are appended to daily files through the real File API
allowed_errors: \[foundation\] ERROR foundation/core: audit record could not be written to foundation/blocked\.txt/
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] ERROR foundation/core: audit record could not be written to foundation/blocked\.txt/audit-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\.log; record kept in this log line reason=.*Cannot create a file.* record=.*foundation:fallback_marker

core-packages.description: Package registration follows the real Load/Unload events across reload and unload
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-packages-fixture disabled: package unloaded

core-runtime.description: Foundation boots, exports its read-only global and disables packages at server stop
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-core-runtime-test disabled: Foundation is stopping

core-runtime-reload.description: Reloading Foundation alone is reported with a recovery command
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] WARN  foundation/core: Foundation was unloaded while 1 package\(s\) still use it \(foundation-core-runtime-reload-test\).*Run 'package reload foundation-core-runtime-reload-test' or restart the server

core-lifecycle.description: Reloading a dependent or a dependency through the real Foundation global
expected_log_lines: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-lifecycle-beta disabled: a dependency was disabled

core-shutdown.description: At server stop, packages are disabled newest first, dependents before dependencies

docs-examples.description: Examples shown in the public documentation run as documented
expected_log_sequence: \[foundation\] INFO  foundation/core: foundation-example-greeter disabled: Foundation is stopping
